SEARCH
Package Server

Class NoShowService

java.lang.Object
Server.NoShowService
public class NoShowService extends Object
periodic sweep that detects visitors who never checked in after their scheduled visit time.

every 5 minutes the service queries for CONFIRMED orders on today's date where entry_time IS NULL and the scheduled time plus a configurable grace period has already passed. each such order is atomically marked no_show and the freed slot is offered to the waiting list via DBController.markNoShowsAndPromote(int).

singleton; call start(DBController) once in serverStarted(). the executor thread is a daemon so it never blocks JVM shutdown. all UI work is marshalled onto the JavaFX Application Thread.
